author: benshapiro
text:
Bill Burr remains a turd. After spending a year celebrating the murder of a CEO at the hands of Luigi Mangione, he’s now criticizing CEOs for getting security. Presumably he’d rather they consider what they did to cause their own murders as they bleed out.
